searchText: I forget, what is people's thinking here on address space *compression* instead of expansion? This is the "choose a 4 byte prefix, ban it today, later make it required for nonzero-period addresses" route So addresses stay within the 20 byte range, but the tradeoff is that you lose collision resistance Though it turns out that collision resistance is only required for some very narrow use cases <@!420501213327392770> you had thoughts here too I think?
